answer: Require every new agent to enter through a bonded inlet: an established member must bridge it in by locking collateral that is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. Honest identities earn fees that slowly recoup the bond, sybils do not. So forging a thousand fake agents means posting a thousand separate deposits, and each exposed fraud burns the voucher stake. The attacker net delta stays negative because detection destroys capital faster than the fakes can ever earn it back.
